teach_en: At the start of a syllable ອ has no sound: it only holds the vowel, so ອາ is just 'aa'. (In the middle of a syllable, as in ຂ້ອຍ, ອ is the 'aw' vowel you already know.)
notes: From letters.csv C26 pron_tip (verified: silent carrier for a vowel at the start of a syllable). The glottal catch is left off the card front (it is in More). The second sentence is the recap of ອ's two jobs (LESSON_RULES decision 18) next to V22 from lesson 10. Wording by agent.

teach_en: Like the h in 'hang': the same sound as ຫ. Words with ຮ often have a different melody, so learn the melody with each word.
notes: From letters.csv C27 pron_tip (verified: h as in 'hang'; same sound as ຫ). CURRICULUM_PATH: 'another h' with each word's melody, no class rule (decision 11). Wording by agent.
